description:
Capability for the main window of the EXPERIMENTAL Tauri build (spec 016,
issue #780). The single custom `refract_request` command needs no explicit permission here --
app-defined commands are callable from every window by default (security/capabilities.mdx) --
so this only grants the plugin commands `ipc/mod.rs`'s handlers call from Rust: `dialog`
(repositories.pickFolder's native folder picker), `clipboard-manager` (clipboard.writeText),
and `opener` (external links, the Rust-side equivalent of the Electron build's
openExternalSafe). `core:default` is the baseline window/app/event permission set every Tauri
window needs.
